diameterInterpretation: Approximate scale from a thermal diameter of 16.421 ± 0.362 km. Quoted fit error excludes about 10% survey systematic uncertainty and shape/aspect effects.

calibration.reference: Masiero et al. (2014), PDS NEOWISE Diameters and Albedos V2.0, reference codeMas14
calibration.notes: NEOWISE Mas14 original record. Fitted diameter; minimum ensemble systematic uncertainty about 10%, additional to quoted formal uncertainty.
calibration.basis: effective spherical radiometric diameter applied as approximate volume-equivalent size
calibration.assumption: Uniformly scale the independently inferred convex shape to the reported effective thermal diameter. This does not establish a measured volume or shape-matched thermophysical calibration; quoted catalog errors exclude shape/orientation and survey systematic uncertainty.
calibration.formalErrorDefinition: statistical 1σ from fitted data; excludes stated survey systematic floor and shape/rotation sampling assumptions
calibration.sourceLabel: Masiero et al. (2014), PDS NEOWISE Diameters and Albedos V2.0, reference codeMas14

modelLimitations: The convex inversion resolves the broad shape; craters and concavities are unresolved. The selected pole is one of the published alternatives.
